proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $1 to $10 free credits upon account creation (equivalent to ~300 to 3000 FLUX.1-schnell images at $0.003/img). No subscription required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides lightning-fast, highly optimized API endpoints for state-of-the-art open-source image generators (FLUX.1-schnell, FLUX.1-dev, SD3.5) with native Python SDK support.
proposals.would_integrate_where: GitHub Actions image generation step (e.g., `produce_coloring_book` or `produce_kdp_cover`), replacing Pollinations for high-definition, commercial-grade illustrations.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Credits will eventually run out, requiring a top-up, but pricing is strictly pay-as-you-go (extremely cheap, fits within the 20€/month budget easily).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 1,000,000 free tokens per month via API.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any web URL (including search results, blogs, e-commerce listings) into clean, LLM-friendly Markdown format in a single API call.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Trend hunting scripts (like `agent_trendhunter` or `agent_opportunity_hunter`) running in GitHub Actions to scrape and analyze niche opportunities from public forums, marketplaces, or social media.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Standard web scraping limitations apply if the target site blocks Jina's proxy IPs (e.g., heavy Cloudflare protection).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2,500 free search queries upon registration, no credit card required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Extremely fast and reliable Google Search API. Specifically offers structured JSON outputs for Google Images, Shopping, and Autocomplete search queries.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Niche validation automation scripts to query search volume, autocomplete suggestions, and competitive products before initiating a book or asset production pipeline.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strictly limited to 2,500 requests on the free tier; needs careful scheduling (e.g., run only once per week) to avoid rapid exhaustion.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to open a store and list digital files. Earns per-download royalties from subscribers or direct sales.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A massive, hyper-targeted marketplace for digital assets (SVG cuts, coloring pages, KDP templates, embroidery files). Users are actively looking for ready-to-use digital assets rather than physical prints.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Parallel distribution pipeline. Every SVG pack or coloring book PDF generated for Amazon KDP/Redbubble can be cross-posted directly here to monetize digital-native crafters.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Payouts are aggregated and have minimum thresholds; strict quality and copyright control on listed SVGs.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list digital PDFs, card decks, and maps. Standard royalty split (up to 70% to creator).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The absolute largest marketplace for tabletop RPG assets, rulesets, print-and-play card games, and isometric map packs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Exporting print-and-play card games (`produce_card_game`) or tabletop assets generated programmatically as PDF packages for direct digital download.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Target audience expects high thematic quality and cohesive design; metadata and descriptions must be well-optimized.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $10 free trial credit upon signup, providing access to FLUX.1-schnell and SDXL at wholesale pricing.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A highly competitive European cloud AI infrastructure player offering ultra-low latency API access to open-source models with strict data privacy compliance.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Fallback image generation API inside GitHub Actions workflows when Together AI or Cloudflare Workers AI hit rate limits.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Relatively new platform; API schemas or pricing models might shift as they exit promotional phases.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free. Uses public Hugging Face Spaces infrastructure.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows programmatic execution of any active public Gradio app hosted on Hugging Face Spaces (such as Kokoro TTS audio generation or niche image upscalers) directly from Python.
proposals.would_integrate_where: GitHub Actions Python workflows to tap into state-of-the-art TTS (audiobook generation) or image processing (upscaling) without needing dedicated API keys or local hardware.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Public spaces can be slow, rate-limited, or paused by their creators without warning. Best suited as a powerful experimental or fallback layer.
